purpose: Teach: 欠く/相応しい/熟成/建国/伝播/正論/覚醒/呈し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、欠くべからざる人材、若手にも、たくさん、いるな、本当に、財産だ、彼らを、大事にしていけ、本当に、頼むぞ。
lines.en: We have indispensable talent among our younger staff too — genuinely a treasure. Cherish them, truly.
lines.style: Measured authority. Slow, deliberate pacing with slight pauses between clauses. Weight on 'indispensable.' Warm underneath the formality. Closing softens with genuine conviction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業理念に、相応しい行動、社員、心がけてくれております、本当に、ありがたいですね、社長、感謝しております。
lines.en: Yes. Our staff are mindful of actions that honor the founding philosophy. It's truly something to be grateful for, sir. We're very grateful.
lines.style: Respectful, measured response. Even cadence. Formal register but genuine — not rote. Slight emphasis on 'grateful.' Eyes steady. No rush, careful completion of the thought.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 新製品、市場で、しっかり、熟成させてから、本格展開だ、急がず、慎重に、進めろ、絶対に、間違うなよ、本当に。
lines.en: The new product needs to mature in the market before we go full-scale. Move carefully. Don't rush. Absolutely don't make a mistake here.
lines.style: Firm, direct instruction. Sharp attack on each key phrase. Deliberate pacing — each sentence lands. The final warning carries quiet weight without raising volume. Controlled intensity.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。建国記念日、社内、特別行事、毎年、開催しております、伝統として、引き継いでまいります、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. We host a special company event every founding day, and we're carrying on that tradition. It means a lot to us.
lines.style: Steady, earnest update. Even tempo. Pride beneath the formality — the kind of report someone is genuinely proud to deliver. Slight warmth on the closing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社のブランド、業界、伝播していく工夫、本当に、必要だ、若手の新しい発想、活かしていけ、本当に、頼んだぞ。
lines.en: Our brand needs to gain traction across the industry. Put our younger staff's fresh ideas to work. That's what I'm asking of you.
lines.style: Authoritative but not cold. Deliberate pacing on key directives. Slight lean into 'fresh ideas' — genuine interest, not dismissiveness. Closing carries weight and trust.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。正論だけでは、社員、動かない、社長の、お言葉、心に、響くんですよね、社員、本当に、お話、楽しみにしています。
lines.en: Yes. Right words alone don't move people, sir. Your words actually reach their hearts. The staff really look forward to what you have to say.
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine observation. Slower pace — each phrase considered. Soft respect in the delivery. Slight hesitation before the compliment shows sincerity over flattery.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員一人一人、本当に、自分の使命に、覚醒して欲しい、創業精神、引き継いでいって欲しい、本当に、頼んだぞ、心から。
lines.en: I want each person to awaken to their own mission. I want them to carry the founding spirit forward. That's what I'm asking, from the heart.
lines.style: Deep conviction. Slower, more measured than before. Weight on 'awaken' and 'spirit.' Vulnerability on the final phrase — the heartfelt request beneath the authority. Slight tremor of genuine care.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。創業精神、社員、本当に、新しい姿、呈してきておりますね、社長、私たち、誇りに、思っております、本当に。
lines.en: Yes. The staff are showing a new face to the founding spirit, sir. We take real pride in that. Truly, we do.
lines.style: Quiet pride. Steady, even cadence. Respectful but warm — not ceremonial. Slight emphasis on 'new face' and 'pride.' The closing is personal, not performative.
